notes: Orb physics, pickup and the XP value are ported server-side (item_entity.c, drops.c, survival.c); only the client spawn packet is missing. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the renderer draws orbs from server state (by design). Formerly listed as missing: The client's XP-orb entity mirror: TRACKER_PKT_S11 is reserved in the tracker enum but never emitted or applied; the live client never holds orb entities (the renderer draws them from the server's state, csrc/engine/raster_entities.c).
